preconditions.description: The input contains at least the header line, the building types line, m road lines, and q query lines.
The number of cities, roads, and queries are all at least 1.
The list of building types T has exactly n elements.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= t <= 10**9 for t in T)
preconditions.description: Each building type value is between 1 and 10^9 inclusive.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= u <= 10**9 for u in road_weights)
preconditions.description: Each road crowd value is between 1 and 10^9 inclusive.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= x <= n and 1 <= y <= n and x != y for x, y, u in roads)
preconditions.description: Each road connects two distinct cities within the valid range [1, n].

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= x <= n and 1 <= y <= n and 1 <= k <= n for x, y, k in queries)
preconditions.description: Each query specifies valid start/destination cities and a valid k value.

postconditions.description: The output contains exactly one line per query.

postconditions.expression: all((ans == -1) or (ans == min_crowd(x, y, k, T, roads)) for ans, (x, y, k) in zip(output_lines, queries))
postconditions.description: For each query (x, y, k), the output is -1 if no valid path exists, otherwise it is the minimum possible crowd value among all paths from x to y that visit at least k distinct building types.

postconditions.expression: all(isinstance(int(line), int) for line in output_lines)
postconditions.description: Each output line is a valid integer representation.
